description: Renovate for the whole Paddock monorepo (ADR 0014 §8): every Cargo workspace, the one npm workspace and the workflows. One weekly PR for ordinary updates; Angular and Tauri each as one PR across all workspaces; Rust patch updates and lock maintenance per workspace, so an app in release freeze can hold its own; security fixes at any time.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for every non-security update that no group below takes
Angular in every workspace in one PR: one Angular for the family (rule 39)
Tauri's Rust crates and its npm packages together, across every workspace
Rust patch updates one PR per Cargo workspace (crates/, each app), so each lands through that workspace's gates
Gitea Actions only supports v3 of the artifact actions
Node follows .nvmrc, which CI, the paddock-ci image and the host runners must match; bump it by hand
